platform.title: CheckLab console
platform.description: Your clients, their status and usage.
platform.listDescription: Enter a client to operate its screens as support.

empty.title: No clients yet
empty.description: Add the first one: its subdomain, admin and catalogs are created.

noResults.title: No matches
noResults.description: Try another name or clear the filter.

channels.title: Punch channels
channels.description: Where its staff can punch. The platform sets them per client: without the Clock channel, the client's UI shows nothing about the time clock.
channels.createDescription: Where its staff will be able to punch. It can be changed later from the client's detail page.
channels.minHint: Keep at least one channel on.
channels.webHint: Punch from the browser, no extra hardware.
channels.lastChannel: Keep at least one punch channel on.
channels.lastChannelHint: You can't turn off the last active channel.

actions.agentHint: Token for the agent that connects the client's clocks

confirm.suspendMessage: Nobody from this client can sign in and their sessions end immediately. Their data is kept.
confirm.reactivateMessage: Their staff can sign in again at {{host}}.

pickClient.title: Pick a client
pickClient.description: This is a client screen. Enter one from the list or with the selector above.

create.title: New client
create.subtitle: Three things and done: the company, its plan and who runs it.

company.title: Company
company.description: What it's called and where its people sign in.
company.name: Company name
company.slugHelp: Suggested from the name; you can change it. Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only.
company.slugPreview: Their staff will sign in at

plan.title: Plan
plan.description: Sets how many people and clocks they can have. It can be changed later.
plan.noneHint: No limits or billing for now
plan.empty: There are no plans in the catalog yet; the client is created without limits.
plan.customLimit: Set a different people limit for this client

admin.title: Admin
admin.description: The client's first person. They add everyone else.
admin.name: Full name
admin.emailHint: Optional. If you add it, we email them their access.
admin.usernameHint: This is what they sign in with. Suggested from the name; it can't be admin, root or another generic one.
admin.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. They'll be asked to change it on sign-in.

summary.title: How it will look
summary.note: Creating the client also loads its base catalogs (roles, departments and document types).

errors.slug: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only; it can't be app, admin, api or www
errors.commonUsername: Pick a specific one: admin, root and the like aren't allowed

done.title: {{name}} is ready
done.subtitle: Share this access with {{admin}}.
done.emailed: We already emailed this access to {{email}}.
done.notEmailed: No email on file: share this access yourself.
done.onlyNow: The password is shown only now.
done.next1: Share the sign-in address, username and password with their admin.
done.next2: On first sign-in the system asks them to change the password.
done.next3: From their home, a guide walks them through adding staff, schedules and clocks.
done.useThisUser: To test their sign-in use the username {{user}}, not your platform account. If the browser autofills another user, clear it.

plan.title: {{name}}'s plan
plan.subtitle: The plan defines how many people and clocks the client includes.
plan.overLimit: Current usage is above the plan limit: no new people can be added until room is freed or the plan changes.
plan.empty: No active plans: create them in the plans console.

agents.title: Local agent · {{name}}
agents.subtitle: Device credential for CheckLab Agent, the app that syncs the clocks from the client's network.
agents.empty: This client has no agents yet.
agents.tokenOnce: New token (shown only once; copy it now):
agents.tokenHint: Paste it in CheckLab Agent → API connection. Only its hash is stored; if lost, rotate it.
agents.created: Agent created. Save the token: it will not be shown again.
agents.rotated: Token rotated: the previous one no longer works.
agents.revokedToast: Agent revoked: its token stops working.

nothing.title: Welcome
nothing.description: Your account has no screens yet. Ask your admin for access.

onboarding.title: First steps
onboarding.description: Get your account ready in four steps.
onboarding.staffHint: One by one or importing an Excel file.
